label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Wyndham Clark Withdraws
items.text: Wyndham Clark withdrew from the Charles Schwab Challenge at Colonial less than 24 hours after winning the 2026 CJ Cup Byron Nelson with a closing 10-under 60.

items.headline: Clark’s 60 Seals Byron Nelson Win
items.text: Wyndham Clark fired an 11-under 60 to win the CJ Cup Byron Nelson at 30-under 254, beating Si Woo Kim by three shots for his fifth PGA Tour win.

items.headline: Scheffler’s Frustration at Byron Nelson
items.text: Scottie Scheffler slammed his driver twice in frustration during the Byron Nelson final round while chasing Wyndham Clark, drawing angry fan reactions.
